title: How many residents aged 60 and over, and aged 75 and over, lived in each of Kelvane County's six senior-services provider areas on census day in 2020, with each provider's home-delivered meals in FY2026 and its active home-delivered meal clients on 30 September 2026
subdomain: data-integration-record-linkage-entity-resolution (an area agency on aging fuses a formally private census release's block group and block tables with census-day housing counts into counts of older residents for provider areas whose boundaries cut block groups, and conforms its route tablets' delivery log, its case records and the state's death match into each provider's service figures)
prompt_shape: 14: cuts of a distribution per segment, two age cuts for each of six provider areas, beside two service figures for each provider
